deprecated_flag_sensor.title: Deprecated sensor detected
deprecated_flag_sensor.description:
The sensor `{entity_id}` is deprecated: value type 28 widgets, which report Enabled/Disabled, are now exposed as binary sensors with the same name.

Update your dashboards, templates, automations and scripts to use the binary sensor instead, then disable the deprecated sensor and restart Home Assistant.

deprecated_flag_sensor_used.title: Deprecated sensor detected
deprecated_flag_sensor_used.description:
The sensor `{entity_id}` is deprecated: value type 28 widgets, which report Enabled/Disabled, are now exposed as binary sensors with the same name.

It is used in the following automations or scripts:
{items}

Update those, along with any dashboards and templates that use it, to use the binary sensor instead, then disable the deprecated sensor and restart Home Assistant.

set_zone_schedule.name: Set zone schedule
set_zone_schedule.description: Switch a zone to its local schedule or one of the five global schedules. Only schedule templates the controller already reports, and that are complete and stable, are applied.

schedule.name: Schedule name
schedule.description: Select a configured global schedule, or `local` for the zone's own schedule.

set_zone_constant.name: Set zone constant temperature
set_zone_constant.description: Set a zone to a fixed temperature either permanently or for a limited number of minutes, after which the zone returns to its previous mode.

duration_minutes.name: Duration (minutes)
duration_minutes.description: 0 keeps the temperature until changed; 1-1440 limits it to that many minutes.
